messages:
deploybot: [AUTOMATED] Deploy paused for release candidate `rc-2026.03.11` due to incident INC-2026-041 (auth 502 spike in eu-west-1). Canaries aborted and hold applied across staged lanes.

sara: saw it. canary was at ~4.8% traffic. any immediate rollback?

jamal: only eu canaries hit. us-east and asia unaffected.

alex: proposal: pin eu control-plane to v3.4.1 and requeue the RC later. rollback if migrations were involved, but this RC has no schema changes.

morgan_ops: ops oncall here. pin + requeue preferred to minimize churn. if we do rollback we'll throttle DB traffic and watch for connection storms.

priya_pm: need a 1-line customer note for comms. suggested: "We're pausing today's rollout due to authentication instability in EU regions. We're reverting canaries and will reschedule the rollout during a quiet window." ok?

jamal: add "no customer data at risk" to reduce alarm.

priya_pm: updated draft and will send to comms after confirmation.

alex: executing rollback commands now: `kubectl -n prod set image deploy/web web=redwood/web:v3.4.1` then `deploybot rollback --service auth --to v3.4.1 --reason "INC-2026-041"`

oncall-bot: @morgan_ops acknowledged. Incident tag set: `release-hold`. Deploy alerts suppressed.

alex: rollback done. rollback-gitsha: `a1b2c3d`. canary pods terminated, stable pods back to v3.4.1. initial health checks show 200 responses in eu at 03:12 UTC.

morgan_ops: verified 200s and stable metrics. leaving manual hold until infra does quick RC root-cause. ops suggests next window 2026-03-12 03:00-05:00 UTC for requeue.

sara: follow-ups: 1) assign postmortem owner 2) re-run release dry-run on canary infra 3) add auth-specific circuit check to release checklist.

jamal: assigned: priya->comms, alex->rollback notes + sha, morgan_ops->ops verification, sara->release checklist update.

priya_pm: noted. sending comms now.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-041 updated: status=mitigated, hold_state=manual_hold, next_window_proposal=2026-03-12T03:00:00Z.

alex: moving RC to "staged-requeue" and tagging `needs-auth-fix` so it won't auto-retry.

morgan_ops: +1. ops will run a smoke test for 30m in the proposed window and, if stable, we'll lift the hold and resume rollout. :hourglass:
